title: Collaborate with AppVerticals to Improve Thunderbird for Android
creator: techrankerscompany
content:
Hello Thunderbird team,

First of all, thank you for the great work on Thunderbird for Android. I've been following the community discussions and noticed that many users are reporting recurring issues related to email syncing, notifications, account setup, search functionality, and overall app performance.

As a suggestion, it might be worthwhile to collaborate with experienced mobile app development companies such as AppVerticals. Their expertise in Android application development and user experience could help enhance performance, improve stability, and address some of the common issues users are facing.

I'm not affiliated with AppVerticals—I simply believe that bringing in additional expertise or consulting with companies that specialise in mobile app development could benefit the Thunderbird Android project and improve the experience for the growing user base.

What do other community members think? Would collaboration with external mobile development experts be something worth considering?

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing everyone's thoughts.

title: Can't empty my trash
creator: dheianevans
content:
Running version 21.0 on Android 17.

Emptied my trash just this morning. Worked fine. Went to do it tonight, said yes to the confirmation and it just sat there. No deletion. Sent a test message from another acct and that arrived fine, so it's not having problems accessing my server via IMAP.
